messages.subject: revised web site
parts:
I revised the content of the web site with command-line
install and getting started instructions.

I'm very uncertain about what level user to aim
for in the above.

I also left the download section on the home
page and left the version numbers in the tarball
name and in (or near) the links to the tarball.

I'd be happy with just a single download link on the nav
bar, but somewhere the home page has to prominently
indicate which version we're at. R indicates the latest
version indirectly in the "News" section after links to
"download R" and to "CRAN mirror" (which confusingly
go the same place; we skip the mirror level with
Google Code). After selecting a mirror, you get
to another page full of links by platform, and finally
to one or more links for the platform of choice.

I like the way both Eigen and Boost arrange
their downloads. Eigen's layout is over messy
because it's embedded in a family of apps and
the family's nav adds noise (just like Google
Code does on our Google Code page).

- Bob
